episodes.title: To the Stars
episodes.summary: Irene and Franklin York have a secret: a Chamber buried in their backyard which leads to a strange, deserted planet. But surprising revelations make them reevaluate what they think they know about it.

episodes.title: La Capilla
episodes.summary: Franklin and Irene decide what to do with the mysterious man from the Chamber. Single-mother Stella grapples with revealing a family secret to teenaged daughter Toni.

episodes.title: The Caretaker
episodes.summary: As Irene finds a new zest for life, Franklin becomes more suspicious of Jude. In Argentina, a visitor has something important to give Stella and Toni.

episodes.title: Boilermakers
episodes.summary: Irene helps Jude search for someone he has lost. Franklin forms an unexpected bond. Stella begins her mission with help from an old friend.

episodes.title: Driving Lessons
episodes.summary: Irene goes to new lengths to help Jude. Stella and Denise both visit places that haunt their past. Franklin gives Byron an unexpected gift.

episodes.title: Dear Franklin
episodes.summary: A shocking discovery divides Franklin and Irene. Tensions between Stella, Toni, and Nick reach new heights. Jude recruits Denise into his search.

episodes.title: Lake Diving
episodes.summary: Irene, Jude and Denise go on a road trip to find Gabriel, while Franklin and Byron take a journey of their own. Stella and Toni get to know Farnsworth.

episodes.title: Compensation
episodes.summary: Jude makes a difficult decision, while Franklin and Irene reflect on recent events. Stella's mission brings her to the Yorks' doorstep.
